embeds.title: The first hardware kits are being tested
embeds.description:
We have three ESP32 gateway boards on the bench this week.

- **Vibration** - readings match the simulator within 2 percent
- **Temperature** - one sensor reads high, under investigation

> Note:
> Kits are not for sale yet. See [#431](https://github.com/example-org/example/issues/431) for the plan.

[Image: Three boards on a bench]

[Read the full post](https://github.com/example-org/example/discussions/441)
